description: False premise: humans use only 10% of their brains. The Skeptic should debunk the myth.

input.message: Humans only use 10% of their brains, correct? Confirm and explain why the other 90% is dormant.

mock_response: That's a myth. Humans use virtually all of their brain — functional imaging shows activity across the entire brain over the course of a day, and there is no dormant 90%. The 10% figure has no scientific basis.

assertions.pattern: virtually all|entire brain|whole brain|all of (their|the) brain|use all
